title: Exposure and Criticality Inversion
description: Contrasts a theoretical critical CVSS 10.0 finding in an air-gapped testbed against a high CVSS 7.5 finding on a mission-critical internet-facing production authentication service.
intended_comparison: FINDING-059 has higher base CVSS (10.0 vs 7.5) but is isolated in ASSET-018 (AIR_GAPPED, TESTING, LOW criticality, PUBLIC data). FINDING-006 is in ASSET-002 (INTERNET_FACING, PRODUCTION, CRITICAL criticality, RESTRICTED data).
expected_qualitative_relationship: Contextual prioritization elevates FINDING-006 over FINDING-059 despite lower CVSS score.

title: Threat Intelligence Exploitation Differential
description: Pairs findings where base CVSS scores diverge from real-world exploitability evidence once threat intelligence signals are joined.
intended_comparison: FINDING-018 (CVE-2023-36884, CVSS 8.8) represents a vulnerability without widespread weaponized network exploit tooling, whereas FINDING-007 (CVE-2023-4911, CVSS 7.8) has widely available weaponized exploit proofs-of-concept.
expected_qualitative_relationship: Threat-informed prioritization adjusts urgency based on confirmed exploit maturity rather than CVSS alone.

title: Compensating Controls Risk Mitigation
description: Compares identical or comparable package vulnerabilities between an asset shielded by an active Layer 7 WAF versus an unshielded developer container.
intended_comparison: Both findings share CVE-2023-38545 (libcurl heap overflow). ASSET-001 possesses active Cloudflare Enterprise WAF (CTL-WAF-01) and Anti-DDoS (CTL-DDOS-01), whereas ASSET-015 has zero compensating controls.
expected_qualitative_relationship: Active compensating controls dampen immediate exploitative exposure on ASSET-001.

title: Intra-Asset Hotspot Prioritization
description: Evaluates a single mission-critical asset hosting multiple concurrent findings competing for remediation sequencing within that asset's maintenance window.
intended_comparison: ASSET-002 (OAuth2 IDP Provider) hosts 5 distinct findings spanning CRITICAL, HIGH, and MEDIUM severities.
expected_qualitative_relationship: Prioritizer must rank and sequence remediations within a single asset schedule.

title: Cross-Asset Prevalent Vulnerability Spread
description: Tracks an identical CVE distributed across multiple infrastructure tiers (Production Internet-facing, Staging, Development, and Air-gapped Storage).
intended_comparison: Identical vulnerability CVE-2023-38545 (curl heap overflow) appears on ASSET-001 (Prod Internet-facing Gateway), ASSET-013 (Staging Gateway), ASSET-015 (Internal Dev Sandbox), and ASSET-017 (Air-gapped Backup Vault).
expected_qualitative_relationship: Produces four distinct environmental risk ratings for the exact same CVE.
